profile.headline: Lead Software Developer | Python, React, Data Visualization, Web Automation
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
I'm a Lead Developer who builds products that turn complex data into experiences people actually enjoy using. My background is in visual tech and interactive storytelling, which taught me that strong engineering is only half the job; the other half is how it feels to the user.
Most recently at Redbird, I led development of a SaaS platform that brought data collection, AI-driven data transformation, and data visualization together in a single product, serving enterprise clients in national media and consumer goods. On the backend, I worked in Python and Django, using Celery with Redis and RabbitMQ to orchestrate the task scheduling and background processing that kept data flowing through the pipeline. On the frontend, I built interfaces in React and used d3.js to create visualizations that made complex information clear and engaging.
I've worked in very different environments, from enterprise teams at American Airlines to early-stage startups, so I'm comfortable navigating large systems and equally at home moving fast when things are scrappy.
Core skills: Python, Django, Celery, Redis, RabbitMQ, React, d3.js, AI/data pipelines, data visualization, full-stack architecture, technical leadership.
I'm currently exploring my next role. If you're building something where data, AI, and user experience come together, I'd love to connect.

positions.title: Lead Software Developer
positions.description:
Led full-stack development of a SaaS platform combining data collection, AI-driven data transformation, and interactive data visualization for enterprise clients in national media and consumer goods.
• Architected and maintained the Python/Django backend powering the platform's data ingestion and processing workflows.
• Designed asynchronous task scheduling and background processing using Celery, Redis, and RabbitMQ to keep data moving reliably through the AI transformation pipeline.
• Built the React frontend and developed custom d3.js visualizations that turned complex datasets into clear, engaging dashboards for clients.
• Guided technical direction across the stack, balancing product goals, client needs, and system scalability.
• Mentored and guided junior developers through code reviews, technical planning, and hands-on support, helping them grow into productive contributors on the team.
• Collaborated closely with product, design, and client-facing teams to translate requirements into shipped features.

positions.title: Artistic Company Member
positions.description:
Developed hypermedia content for theatrical productions, integrating live performance with interactive audio and video.
• Collaborated with directors, designers, and performers to conceive and develop hypermedia theatrical content.
• Designed and programmed interactive video and media cues in Isadora, creating visuals that responded to live performance.
• Produced and edited audio in Pro Tools and video in Final Cut Pro, building media assets tailored to each production.
• Programmed show playback and cue sequences in QLab to deliver seamless audio and video during live performances.

positions.title: Operations Manager
positions.description:
Supported the growth of a platform from MVP through rebranding, contributing across product development, partnerships, vendor onboarding, and client support.
• Collaborated with the founding team to develop the platform from MVP through a full rebrand, helping shape the product as it matured.
• Identified potential partners and initiated outreach, managing and coordinating contact through Salesforce.
• Designed and documented onboarding procedures that helped vendors get set up and active on the platform.
• Provided client-facing support, troubleshooting platform issues and serving as a point of contact for users.

positions.title: Dispatcher
positions.description:
Managed logistics and team operations for statewide distribution, coordinating inventory, delivery routing, and staff administration.
• Coordinated inventory for statewide orders using logistics software, ensuring stock was allocated and ready for fulfillment.
• Planned daily delivery routes for the delivery fleet with routing software, balancing efficiency and on-time delivery.
• Built and maintained Excel trackers for team payroll, scheduling, and vacation requests, keeping staffing organized and accurate.

positions.title: AAdvantage Customer Service Rep
positions.description:
Provided client-facing support for travel reservations, assisting customers across phone, in-person, and email channels.
• Managed customer bookings, changes, and inquiries using the SABRE computer reservation system.
• Communicated with clients by phone and in person, resolving issues and delivering a positive customer experience.
• Handled email correspondence through KANA email management software, responding to customer requests accurately and promptly.
